source_sql:
-- D-3. LISTAGG（文字列集約）
SELECT department_id,
       LISTAGG(last_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY last_name) AS members
FROM   employees
GROUP  BY department_id

fetch.scalardb_sql: SELECT employee_id, last_name, department_id FROM hr.employees

java.sql: /* D-3. LISTAGG（文字列集約） */ SELECT department_id, LISTAGG(last_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY last_name NULLS LAST) AS members FROM employees GROUP BY department_id

python.sql: /* D-3. LISTAGG（文字列集約） */ SELECT department_id, GROUP_CONCAT(last_name, ', ') AS members FROM employees GROUP BY department_id
